recipes.name: Puppy Paw Hash Browns inspired by Genshin Impact
ingredients: For the Puppy Paw Hash Browns
As needed fry oil of choice
3/8 tsp red pepper flakes (depending on your spice preference)
instructions: For the Puppy Paw Hash Browns
Prepare a large high-sided skillet with about 3 inches of fry oil. Preheat the oil to 275 °F. - As needed fry oil of choice
Peel and cut the potato into 1-inch cubes. - 3 ½ yukon gold potatoes
Transfer the potato cubes into the preheated oil and fry for 4-6 minutes, just until the potatoes have cooked but not gained color.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer the potatoes to a sheet tray lined with paper towels. Allow the potatoes to cool, about 15 minutes.
Working in batches, use a ricer to break down the potatoes.

Combine the broken down potatoes with the flour, pinenuts, egg, garlic, salt and pepper. Combine the mixture by hand or with a plastic spatula until completely homogenous. - 2 tbsp flour - ⅓ cup pine nuts ground - 1 egg - 1 cloves garlic minced - ½ tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
Add the potato mixture to a silicone puppy paw mold. Freeze the molds for at least 1 hour or until the puppy paws release from the molds cleanly.
Meanwhile, preheat the same oil used for the first fry to 350 °F. Strain the oil first if necessary.
Fry the unmolded puppy paws for 3-5 minutes or until deeply golden brown. Transfer the fried puppy paws to a sheet tray lined with paper towels.
Serve the puppy paw hash browns immediately. Serve with broccoli, tomato jam, and garlic aioli.
For the Tomato Jam

Combine all ingredients in a dutch oven and cook for 30-45 minutes or until thick and glossy. - 6 roma tomatoes coarsely chopped - ½ cup sugar - 1 Juice of lemon - 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar - 1 tbsp ginger grated - ⅜ tsp red pepper flakes (depending on your spice preference) - 1 tsp cumin seeds - 1 tsp kosher salt
Store in the refrigerator until ready to use.
For the Garlic Aioli
Combine the garlic and salt in a mortar. Using the pestle, grind them into a paste. - 4 cloves garlic - 1 tsp kosher salt
Add the egg yolks to the mortar and combine the mixture with the pestle. - 1 egg yolks
Very slowly, stream in the oil while mixing with the pestle. - ¾ cup neutral oil
Reserve until ready to serve.
For the Steamed Broccoli
Break the broccoli head into florets and trim the stalks. - 1 head broccoli rinsed
Add 1-2 inches of water to a medium pot. Place a steamer basket inside the pot.
Bring the water to a boil. Add the broccoli to the steamer basket and cover the pot with a lid. Steam the broccoli for 6-8 minutes or until tender.
